record.question: Choose the right preposition or prepositional phrase to fill in the blank: I arranged a party __________ my daughter's birthday.
record.explanation: Answer C: in honour of. “In honour of” means as a tribute or celebration of her birthday. Independent check: A party can be arranged “in honour of” someone or an occasion. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/in-honour-of. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
